#30DayChartChallenge, #Day17 : Makeover
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(countrycode)
library(tidyverse)
library(WDI)
```

```{r}
#2014 data
cia_factbook <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2024/2024-10-22/cia_factbook.csv')
```


```{r}
cia_factbook <- cia_factbook %>% 
  mutate(
    region = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent"),
         est_maternal_deaths = (maternal_mortality_rate / 100000) * 
                                (birth_rate / 1000) * population)%>% 
  na.omit(region)

# Check how many NAs we have in key variables
cia_factbook %>%
  select(country, region, maternal_mortality_rate, birth_rate, est_maternal_deaths) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.))))

# Check the range of both variables
cia_factbook %>%
  select(maternal_mortality_rate, birth_rate) %>%
  summary()

cia_factbook %>%
  arrange(desc(maternal_mortality_rate)) %>%
  select(country, maternal_mortality_rate, birth_rate, region) %>%
  head(10)

cia_factbook %>%
  arrange(maternal_mortality_rate) %>%
  select(country, maternal_mortality_rate, birth_rate, region) %>%
  head(10)
```

Plot
```{r}
windowsFonts(georgia = windowsFont("Georgia"))

# Calculate medians for crosshairs
median_birth <- median(cia_factbook$birth_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
median_mmr <- median(cia_factbook$maternal_mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE)

# Countries to annotate
annotate_countries <- c("Chad", "Estonia", "India")

cia_plot <- cia_factbook %>%
  mutate(label = if_else(country %in% annotate_countries, country, NA_character_))

p <- ggplot(cia_plot, aes(x = birth_rate, y = maternal_mortality_rate, color = region)) +
  # Quadrant crosshairs
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_birth, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median_mmr, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Quadrant labels
  annotate("text", x = 8, y = 1000,
           label = "Low birth rate + High MMR", size = 3,
           color = "grey50", hjust = 0, family = "georgia") +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 1000,
           label = "High birth rate + High MMR",
           size = 3, color = "grey50", hjust = 0, family = "georgia") +
  #annotate("text", x = 20, y = 3,
   #        label = "High birth rate + Low MMR",
    #       size = 3, color = "grey50", hjust = 0, family = "georgia") +
  # Points
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
# Chad arrow and label
annotate("segment", x = 36, xend = 37.3, y = 800, yend = 1100,
         arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
         color = "#1d3557", linewidth = 0.5) +
annotate("text", x = 36, y = 550,
         label = "Chad\nMMR: 1,100", size = 3,
         hjust = 1, family = "georgia", color = "#1d3557") +

# India arrow and label  
annotate("segment", x = 21, xend = 19.9, y = 300, yend = 200,
         arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
         color = "#1d3557", linewidth = 0.5) +
annotate("text", x = 21.5, y = 350,
         label = "India\nMMR: 200", size = 3,
         hjust = 0, family = "georgia", color = "#1d3557") +

# Estonia arrow and label
annotate("segment", x = 13, xend = 10.3, y = 3, yend = 2,
         arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
         color = "#1d3557", linewidth = 0.5) +
annotate("text", x = 12, y = 3,
         label = "Estonia\nMMR: 2", size = 3,
         hjust = 0, family = "georgia", color = "#1d3557") +

  # Log scale y axis
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(2, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000),
                labels = c("2", "10", "50", "100", "500", "1,000")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(7, 45), breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40))+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Region") +
  labs(
    title = "The Global Divide in Maternal Mortality Risk, 2014",
    subtitle = "Maternal mortality rate vs. birth rate by country | CIA Factbook 2014",
    x = "Birth Rate (per 1,000 people)",
    y = "Maternal Mortality Rate\n(per 100,000 live births, log scale)",
    caption = "Dashed lines show global medians | #30DayChartChallenge Day 17\nData: CIA Factbook via TidyTuesday | Created by: Lyndsay Miles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "georgia", size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(family = "georgia", size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(family = "georgia", hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(family = "georgia", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "georgia", size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(family = "georgia", size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "georgia", size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p
ggsave("img/cc_2026_day17.png", p,
       width = 10, height = 6, 
       dpi = 300)

```
